questions.q: What is the last number you say when you count three apples?
questions.why: The script says the last number said is the total, and three apples count to three.

questions.q: When you count things, how many numbers does each object get?
questions.why: The script says each object gets exactly one number.

questions.q: Which number comes right after seven when counting to ten?
questions.why: The script lists seven, eight, nine, ten in order, so eight comes after seven.
